subject.title: feat: show ClawHub skill icons in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw ship skill-owned ClawHub icons in the Control UI once the dependent ClawHub API contract is available?
rationale: This is a new user-facing presentation capability spanning two repositories; the code and proof are credible, but only maintainers can confirm rollout ownership and whether the external API contract is accepted as the permanent source.

options.title: Sponsor coordinated rollout
options.body: Approve the icon contract, merge or deploy the ClawHub API dependency first, then rebase and land this UI consumer.

options.title: Keep publisher identity only
options.body: Decline the new skill-icon surface and close or narrow the PR because the existing publisher-avatar presentation remains the supported design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor coordinated rollout
recommendation.body: Approve the icon contract, merge or deploy the ClawHub API dependency first, then rebase and land this UI consumer.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about cross-repository product direction and rollout sequencing rather than a mechanical code repair.
